baselineDisplay.title: On the Stork Tower (Wang Zhihuan; translated by Xu Yuanchong)

display.title: On the Stork Tower (Wang Zhihuan; translated by Xu Yuanchong)
display.text:
The sun beyond the mountain glows;
The Yellow River seawards flows.
You can enjoy a grander sight
By climbing to a greater height.
